decisions.disposition_scope: Malformed shared blank source identifier; underlying recipe ingredients are not claimed nonchemical. Recipe-specific stock context is retained.
decisions.reasoning: The exact frozen compound1944 object is the J935/solution4947/order12 row for 5 ml of 10% (w/v) BD-Difco yeast-extract stock. Original JCM935 establishes that recipe-row meaning. However the same blank compound_id1944 also labels J935/4947/order13, 20 ml of 10% Trypticase-peptone stock, and J1053/5115/order13, 10 ml of 20% MES solution at pH6.0. Live MediaDive recipes match the frozen API bodies. These three incompatible preparations make the global blank source ID malformed, rather than a single yeast-extract substance. The ingredient endpoint also has a blank name and CHEBI:1; authoritative OLS marks that term obsolete with replacement CHEBI:18357 (R)-noradrenaline, which does not identify these stocks. Neither a generic yeast-extract owner nor that source xref can resolve this source ID safely. No global alias, new owner, parent mapping or SSSOM row is justified.
decisions.applicability: Every claim is bound to the assigned original case digest and source ID1944. The full admitted-generation scan and frozen/live source bodies establish the exact canary row and the other contexts of that same ID; this does not add other campaign cases to reviewed scope.
decisions.no_change_reason: No single material identity exists across the observed uses of this shared blank source ID. No MIM owner is identified; generic yeast extract is only contextual. Preserve source placeholders and all existing WITHHOLD/REJECTED/source-material holds.
decisions.missing_requirement: MediaDive must separate or correct the three recipe associations, or an explicitly supported downstream correction must bind each to its medium, solution, list position/order and exact raw-content hash while preserving ID1944 as original provenance. Preserve the 10% yeast, 10% Trypticase and 20% MES stock contexts, supplier labels where present, pH, amount and unit. Before any MIM stock/product proposal, establish a stable distinct preparation identity and complete supplied specification; a catalog ID is needed only for product-specific claims. Re-review the exact owner payload and applicable publication assertions. JCM already settles recipe-row intent; another generic yeast-extract lookup cannot settle the reused ID.
